space-3.$description: Gaps between buttons and list rows.

space-4.$description: Inner gaps in tiles; gap between app cards.

space-5.$description: Side margin of app screens; tile padding.

space-6.$description: Card padding and the gap between web cards.

space-12.$description: Between sections on mobile; how far an overlapping element may hang past its panel.

space-16.$description: Between sections on desktop; stage padding.

radius-sm.$description: Amenity icon tiles, thumbnails and small squares.

radius-md.$description: App tiles, list cards and booking rows.

radius-lg.$description: Cards (web and app) and feature cards.

radius-xl.$description: Panels, bottom sheets and the web stage panel.

radius-pill.$description: Every button, chip, toggle, nav bar, nav item, week strip and tab bar.

blur-glass.$description: `glass` panels, menus and the tab bar.

display-xl.$description: Hero lines and the name set in type. Uppercase.

display-l.$description: Web hero card titles and app screen titles (Olá, Helena; Agenda). Sentence case.

heading.$description: Card and tile titles, sentence case.

eyebrow.$description: Wide-tracked uppercase labels above titles, in `emerald` or `ink-muted`.

lead.$description: The one sentence under a hero title.

body.$description: Default card text; one sentence per card.

label.$description: Button and chip labels: one word whenever possible.

caption.$description: Metadata, tile counts and tab captions in `ink-muted`.

surface.$description: Cinza Névoa: the deepest layer, the page ground of every web and app screen. Night: deep brown.

surface-panel.$description: The middle layer: large panels and sheets that hold cards, one step above `surface`.

surface-raised.$description: Branco Pérola: the top layer. Cards, tiles, nav bar, chips and white pill buttons.

surface-deboss.$description: The sunken pill behind the active nav item (low relief).

ink.$description: Marrom Luxo as the text color: headings and body on `surface`, `surface-panel` and `surface-raised` (8.5:1 or more in both themes).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface`, `surface-panel`, `surface-raised` and `surface-deboss` (5.2:1 or more in both themes).

border.$description: Input and control outlines; 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

hairline.$description: Decorative dividers inside cards and lists. Not a control border.

emerald.$description: Verde Esmeralda: the primary action and the active state (Reservar, selected day, toggle on, FAB). Gradient start; text on it is `on-emerald`. 5.2:1 as text on `surface` in Day.

emerald-deep.$description: The dark end of the emerald gradient and the silk shadows on emerald cards. Never a flat fill on its own.

on-emerald.$description: Text and icons on `emerald` fills (6.2:1); `gold` also reads on emerald (5.4:1) for titles.

gold.$description: Ouro: highlights, the one special card per screen, price tags and the secondary pill button. Text on it is `on-gold`. Never text on light surfaces.

gold-deep.$description: The warm end of the gold gradient and the neon color on brown buttons. Decorative, not text.

brown.$description: Marrom Luxo as a fill: the tertiary pill button and dark accents. Text on it is `on-brown`.

neon.$description: The neon stroke that runs around a button's border on hover and lights fully when clicked or selected. Decorative light, never text.

neon-hot.$description: The bright head of the running neon stroke.

glass.$description: Translucent panel (with `blur-glass`) floating over imagery: the web stage panel, menus, modal panels. `ink` stays legible over any content.

glass-bar.$description: The app tab bar and floating bars (with `blur-glass`); icons in `ink-muted`, active in `emerald`.

glass-hover.$description: Translucent shading of a nav item or menu row on hover.

scrim.$description: The dimmed layer behind a modal or bottom sheet (`blur-scrim`). Never behind menus.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with a 4px offset; 5:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

lift-1.$description: Level 1: small elements resting on a card (avatars, thumbnails).

lift-2.$description: Level 2: cards and tiles floating over a panel.

lift-3.$description: Level 3: the panel, the nav bar, the tab bar, emerald feature cards and anything that overlaps another layer.

rim.$description: The light-catching top edge every raised surface carries, combined with a `lift-*`.

relief-pearl.$description: High relief for white pill buttons, chips, icon buttons and knobs.

relief-emerald.$description: High relief for emerald pill buttons, the FAB and selected chips.

relief-gold.$description: High relief for gold pill buttons, price tags and the avatar.

relief-brown.$description: High relief for brown pill buttons.

deboss.$description: Low relief: the pressed state of every button and the sunken pill of the active nav item.

neon-glow.$description: Static glow for a selected element where the animated ring cannot be drawn.
